北电礼堂前面，是一个表演舞台。红丝绒二道幕自然垂落，厚重的丝绒大幕被稳稳收束在台口两侧的立柱上，用专用幕带整齐捆扎成饱满的垂坠束状。
前檐幕上挂着标语——“欢迎刘济民同志来我校做巡回报告”。
几扇窗户打开，窗户旁挂着蓝丝绒窗帘，旁边的墙皮发黄。下面的听众坐在板凳上，都在打量着刘济民。
铁玄通身为师长，却也没有半分师傅的样子，同样好奇的打量着四周。
“就是，没见他提着剑鞘吗？总不至于是故意显摆吧。”清澈的声音如一阵秋凉之风，有股萧索感，众人那刚刚躁动不安的心火立马便退了不少。
向导急忙跳下马背，把清水、干粮拿了出来，紧紧绑在自己身上。
事到如今，罗迪只剩下了一种选择：带着所有人，全速奔向帕卡罗城。
有了这番话语，原本惴惴不安的法师和奥能武士们终于重拾信心，紧绷的面容也缓解了不少，一个个迅速忙碌起来。
凌风脚踏虚空，掀起一阵狂风，长袍猎猎而动，在黑暗中飘动不止。
毕竟，境界相差太大了。境界相差太大的时候，并不是用人数就能弥补的。
黑鱼从楚狂身边飞向林风，苍老的声音在林风，楚狂二人耳边响起。
“胖子的爸妈和他爷爷就在这栋房子里，我们进去吧！”奶奶说完，抬脚迈上台阶，胖子很赶眼色的上前推开门，众人先后进到屋内。
一掌拍出，黑色的真气瞬间成形，乌气蜿转，化为了一道蛇影，于光芒下散发着乌光，当中有很重的湿气在弥漫。
刹那间，可怕的震动让伊海的手臂直接传来了剧痛，随后是身体，最后是脑袋，这样的剧痛直接让伊海的大脑给拉了闸，而后便是一片黑暗。
守卫在入口处的人看着伊海的身影，立即过来阻止，但是走到一半就被一旁的人拉住了。
这么一桌子精致的饭菜，公子一口都没吃上，劲风都替公子可惜，但总不能浪费了吧？
凝瑶不可思议的看着周围这一圈儿妖魔鬼怪，什么跟什么？她有种想要原地爆炸的感觉。
这一点到是没有什么需要隐瞒的，伊海直接和米斯提亚解释了一下EGO的作用，而后坐在了一旁的沙发上。
没有打开灯光的房间中，一双暗金色的瞳孔在黑暗之中绽放着淡淡的光芒。那是一双毫无机质的眼睛，没有光泽，瞳孔之中似乎有奇怪的东西在翻转着。
因为家里供奉的那位出窍境强者恐怕也不是对手，出于恐惧，家主亲自上门道歉，说是鬼迷心窍，受人挑拨，才会对瑞瑞家出手。
之前古伦萨还处于超凡奥术师级别的时候，由于兑换了见神层次的国术，肉身的强大远超过了现有的精神之海的强度，于是强大的身体被动的蕴养、促进着精神之海的壮大。
现在事情已经发生，你再怎么生气也无济于事，最重要的是现在怎么补救？
“爸爸，霆钧他知道了什么？”要是被他知道了什么，后果不堪设想。
“你跟我道歉干什么？你哪里做错了吗？我真不希望你习惯说对不起这三个字！”张扬说话声音并不大，但每个字都如同跳跃的音符，铿锵有力，掷地有声。
“什么东西？居然让我心都颤抖！”孟于轩感受到那一道震鸣的响声，他的心都随着那一道巨响振动。

In front of the Nortel Auditorium is a performance stage. The two red velvet curtains hang down naturally, and the thick velvet curtain is firmly tied to the pillars on both sides of the stage entrance, and neatly tied into a full hanging bundle with special curtain tapes.
A slogan hung on the front eaves - "Comrade Liu Jimin is welcome to come to our school to give a tour report."
Several windows were open, and blue velvet curtains were hung beside them. The wall next to them was yellow. The audience below were sitting on the bench, looking at Liu Jimin.
Tie Xuantong was a teacher, but he didn't look like a master at all. He looked around curiously.
"It's just that you didn't see him holding the scabbard? It's not like he was showing off on purpose." The clear voice was like a cool autumn wind, with a sense of desolation, and the restless anger of everyone immediately subsided a lot.
The guide hurriedly jumped off the horse, took out the water and dry food, and tied them tightly to himself.
At this point, Roddy had only one choice left: take everyone with him and rush to Pacaro City at full speed.
With these words, the originally anxious mages and arcane warriors finally regained their confidence, their tense faces also relaxed a lot, and they all quickly became busy.
Ling Feng stepped into the void and stirred up a gust of wind. His robes moved wildly, fluttering in the darkness.
After all, the realms are too different. When the difference in realm is too large, it cannot be made up for by the number of people.
Black Fish flew from Chu Kuang's side to Lin Feng, and the old voice rang in the ears of Lin Feng and Chu Kuang.
"The fat man's parents and his grandfather are in this house. Let's go in!" After grandma said that, she stepped up the steps. The fat man quickly stepped forward and opened the door, and everyone entered the house one after another.
With a palm shot, the black Qi took shape instantly. The black Qi twisted and turned into a snake shadow, emitting a black light under the light, and there was heavy moisture in it.
In an instant, the terrible vibration caused severe pain to come directly to Yi Hai's arm, then to his body, and finally to his head. Such severe pain directly shut down Yi Hai's brain, and then there was darkness.
The person guarding the entrance looked at Yi Hai's figure and immediately came to stop him, but was stopped by someone on the side when he was halfway there.
The young master didn't eat a single bite of such a table of exquisite food. Jinfeng felt sorry for the young master, but it couldn't be wasted, right?
Ningyao looked at the monsters and monsters around her in disbelief. What are they following? She felt like she wanted to explode on the spot.
There was nothing to hide at this point. Yi Hai directly explained the function of EGO to Mistia, and then sat on the sofa nearby.
In the room where the lights were not turned on, a pair of dark golden pupils glowed faintly in the darkness. They were a pair of lifeless eyes, without luster, and something strange seemed to be flipping in the pupils.
Because the strong man in the out-of-body realm enshrined in his family was probably no match for him. Out of fear, the head of the family came to apologize in person, saying that he was obsessed and provoked by others, so he attacked Ruirui's family.
When Gurunsa was still at the level of extraordinary arcanist, due to the exchange of national arts at the level of seeing the gods, the physical body was far more powerful than the existing spiritual sea, so the powerful body passively nourished and promoted the growth of the spiritual sea.
Now that things have happened, no matter how angry you are, it will not help. The most important thing is how to remedy it now?
"Dad, what did Tingjun know?" If he knew anything, the consequences would be disastrous.
"Why are you apologizing to me? What did you do wrong? I really don't want you to get used to saying I'm sorry!" Zhang Yang's voice was not loud, but every word was like a jumping note, sonorous, powerful and loud.
"What? It actually makes my heart tremble!" Meng Yuxuan felt the roaring sound, and his heart vibrated with the loud noise.
